tasks.subject: Task 3: MumbleManager cue wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Enable flag + persistence, SoundCues instance, chat cue, after-sync join/leave collector.

**Files:** Modify mumble/MumbleManager.kt

**Acceptance:** soundCuesEnabled flow + setter persist + load (default true); onTextMessage plays chat cue when enabled; collector in ActiveSession.start() using sm.state.flatMapLatest{if Synchronized model.state else emptyFlow()} (NOT combine — stale-roster race) with @OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi); disconnect() releases SoundCues.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest
